verses.original: Ὥστε ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοὶ καὶ ἐπιπόθητοι χαρὰ καὶ στέφανός μου οὕτως στήκετε ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀγαπητοί
verses.transliteration: Hōste adelphoi mou agapētoi kai epipothētoi chara kai stephanos mou houtōs stēkete en Kyriō agapētoi
verses.literal: Therefore my brothers whom I love and long for my joy and crown that is how you must stand firm in the Lord my beloved
verses.literalPt: Portanto, meus amados e saudosos irmãos, minha alegria e coroa, estai assim firmes no Senhor, caríssimos.

verses.original: Εὐοδίαν παρακαλῶ καὶ Συντύχην παρακαλῶ τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Euodian parakalō kai Syntychēn parakalō to auto phronein en Kyriō
verses.literal: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord
verses.literalPt: Rogo a Evódia e rogo a Síntique que sintam o mesmo no Senhor.

verses.original: ναὶ ἐρωτῶ καὶ σέ γνήσιε σύζυγε συλλαμβάνου αὐταῖς αἵτινες ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ συνήθλησάν μοι μετὰ καὶ Κλήμεντος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν συνεργῶν μου ὧν τὰ ὀνόματα ἐν βίβλῳ ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: nai erōtō kai se gnēsie syzyge syllambanou autais haitines en tō euangeliō synēthlēsan moi meta kai Klēmentos kai tōn loipōn synergōn mou hōn ta onomata en biblō zōēs
verses.literal: Yes and I ask you my true yokefellow to help these women who have contended at my side for the gospel along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers whose names are in the Book of Life
verses.literalPt: A ti, fiel companheiro, também suplico que as ajudes, porque trabalharam comigo no evangelho e em companhia de Clemente com os outros meus cooperadores, cujos nomes estão no livro da vida.

verses.original: Χαίρετε ἐν Κυρίῳ πάντοτε πάλιν ἐρῶ χαίρετε
verses.transliteration: Chairete en Kyriō pantote palin erō chairete
verses.literal: Rejoice in the Lord always I will say it again Rejoice
verses.literalPt: Regozijai-vos sempre no Senhor; outra vez digo: regozijai-vos.

verses.original: τὸ ἐπιεικὲς ὑμῶν γνωσθήτω πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις ὁ Κύριος ἐγγύς
verses.transliteration: to epieikes hymōn gnōsthētō pasin anthrōpois ho Kyrios engys
verses.literal: Let your gentleness be apparent to all . . . The Lord is near
verses.literalPt: A vossa mansidão seja conhecida de todos os homens. O Senhor está perto.

verses.original: Μηδὲν μεριμνᾶτε ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ τῇ δεήσει μετὰ εὐχαριστίας τὰ αἰτήματα ὑμῶν γνωριζέσθω πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Mēden merimnate all’ en panti tē proseuchē kai tē deēsei meta eucharistias ta aitēmata hymōn gnōrizesthō pros ton Theon
verses.literal: Be anxious for nothing but in everything by prayer and petition with thanksgiving present your requests to God
verses.literalPt: Não andeis cuidadosos de coisa alguma; antes, em tudo sejam conhecidos os vossos pedidos diante de Deus, pela oração e pela súplica, com ações de graças.

verses.original: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ ὑπερέχουσα πάντα νοῦν φρουρήσει τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ νοήματα ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hē eirēnē tou Theou hē hyperechousa panta noun phrourēsei tas kardias hymōn kai ta noēmata hymōn en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: And the peace of God which surpasses all understanding will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: A paz de Deus, que excede todo o entendimento, guardará os vossos corações e os vossos pensamentos em Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: Τὸ λοιπόν ἀδελφοί ὅσα ἐστὶν ἀληθῆ ὅσα σεμνά ὅσα δίκαια ὅσα ἁγνά ὅσα προσφιλῆ ὅσα εὔφημα εἴ τις ἀρετὴ καὶ εἴ τις ἔπαινος ταῦτα λογίζεσθε
verses.transliteration: To loipon adelphoi hosa estin alēthē hosa semna hosa dikaia hosa hagna hosa prosphilē hosa euphēma ei tis aretē kai ei tis epainos tauta logizesthe
verses.literal: Finally brothers whatever is true whatever is honorable whatever is right whatever is pure whatever is lovely whatever is admirable if anything is excellent or praiseworthy think on these things
verses.literalPt: Finalmente, irmãos, tudo o que é verdadeiro, tudo o que é venerável, tudo o que é justo, tudo o que é puro, tudo o que é amável, tudo o que é de boa fama, se há alguma virtude e se há algum louvor, seja isso o que ocupe os vossos pensamentos.

verses.original: ἃ καὶ ἐμάθετε καὶ παρελάβετε καὶ ἠκούσατε καὶ εἴδετε ἐν ἐμοί ταῦτα πράσσετε καὶ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ha kai emathete kai parelabete kai ēkousate kai eidete en emoi tauta prassete kai ho Theos tēs eirēnēs estai meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me or seen in me put it into practice . . . And the God of peace will be with you
verses.literalPt: O que também aprendestes, recebestes e ouvistes de mim e em mim vistes, isso praticai; e o Deus de paz será convosco.

verses.original: Ἐχάρην δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ μεγάλως ὅτι ἤδη ποτὲ ἀνεθάλετε τὸ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ φρονεῖν ἐφ’ ᾧ καὶ ἐφρονεῖτε ἠκαιρεῖσθε δέ
verses.transliteration: Echarēn de en Kyriō megalōs hoti ēdē pote anethalete to hyper emou phronein eph’ hō kai ephroneite ēkaireisthe de
verses.literal: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me You were indeed concerned but you had no opportunity to show it
verses.literalPt: Muito me alegro no Senhor de que já, por fim, tenhais renovado o vosso cuidado para comigo, o qual sempre tínheis, mas vos faltava oportunidade.

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι καθ’ ὑστέρησιν λέγω ἐγὼ γὰρ ἔμαθον ἐν οἷς εἰμι αὐτάρκης εἶναι
verses.transliteration: ouch hoti kath’ hysterēsin legō egō gar emathon en hois eimi autarkēs einai
verses.literal: I am not saying this out of need for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Não digo isso por causa da necessidade, pois eu, da minha parte tenho aprendido a contentar-me com as circunstâncias em que me acho.

verses.original: οἶδα καὶ ταπεινοῦσθαι οἶδα καὶ περισσεύειν ἐν παντὶ καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν μεμύημαι καὶ χορτάζεσθαι καὶ πεινᾶν καὶ περισσεύειν καὶ ὑστερεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: oida kai tapeinousthai oida kai perisseuein en panti kai en pasin memyēmai kai chortazesthai kai peinan kai perisseuein kai hystereisthai
verses.literal: I know how to live humbly and I know how to abound In any and every situation I have learned the secret of being filled and being hungry of having plenty and having need
verses.literalPt: Sei ainda viver na penúria e sei também viver na abundância; em tudo e em todas as coisas, sei o que é ter fartura e ter fome, ter abundância e padecer necessidade.

verses.original: πάντα ἰσχύω ἐν τῷ ἐνδυναμοῦντί με
verses.transliteration: panta ischyō en tō endynamounti me
verses.literal: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength . . .
verses.literalPt: Tudo posso naquele que me fortalece.

verses.original: Πλὴν καλῶς ἐποιήσατε συνκοινωνήσαντές μου τῇ θλίψει
verses.transliteration: Plēn kalōs epoiēsate synkoinōnēsantes mou tē thlipsei
verses.literal: Nevertheless you have done well to share in my affliction
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, fizestes bem em tomar parte na minha tribulação.

verses.original: οἴδατε δὲ καὶ ὑμεῖς Φιλιππήσιοι ὅτι ἐν ἀρχῇ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ὅτε ἐξῆλθον ἀπὸ Μακεδονίας οὐδεμία μοι ἐκκλησία ἐκοινώνησεν εἰς λόγον δόσεως καὶ λήμψεως εἰ μὴ ὑμεῖς μόνοι
verses.transliteration: oidate de kai hymeis Philippēsioi hoti en archē tou euangeliou hote exēlthon apo Makedonias oudemia moi ekklēsia ekoinōnēsen eis logon doseōs kai lēmpseōs ei mē hymeis monoi
verses.literal: And as you Philippians know in the early days of the gospel when I left . . . Macedonia no church but . . . you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving
verses.literalPt: Também vós sabeis, filipenses, que, no princípio da minha pregação do evangelho, quando parti da Macedônia, nenhuma igreja comunicou comigo na relação de dar e receber, senão vós somente;

verses.original: ὅτι καὶ ἐν Θεσσαλονίκῃ καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δὶς εἰς τὴν χρείαν μοι ἐπέμψατε
verses.transliteration: hoti kai en Thessalonikē kai hapax kai dis eis tēn chreian moi epempsate
verses.literal: For even while I was in Thessalonica you provided for my needs again and again
verses.literalPt: porque, estando eu ainda em Tessalônica, mandastes não uma vez, mas duas, a acudir às minhas necessidades.

verses.original: Οὐχ ὅτι ἐπιζητῶ τὸ δόμα ἀλλὰ ἐπιζητῶ τὸν καρπὸν τὸν πλεονάζοντα εἰς λόγον ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ouch hoti epizētō to doma alla epizētō ton karpon ton pleonazonta eis logon hymōn
verses.literal: Not that I am seeking a gift but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account
verses.literalPt: Não é porque procure eu dádivas, mas procuro o fruto que cresça para a vossa conta.

verses.original: ἀπέχω δὲ πάντα καὶ περισσεύω πεπλήρωμαι δεξάμενος παρὰ Ἐπαφροδίτου τὰ παρ’ ὑμῶν ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας θυσίαν δεκτήν εὐάρεστον τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: apechō de panta kai perisseuō peplērōmai dexamenos para Epaphroditou ta par’ hymōn osmēn euōdias thysian dektēn euareston tō Theō
verses.literal: I have all I need and more now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus They are a fragrant offering . . . an acceptable sacrifice well-pleasing to God
verses.literalPt: Porém tenho todo o necessário, em tudo tenho abundância; estou cheio, tendo recebido de Epafrodito o que me mandastes, com um cheiro suave, como um sacrifício aceitável e aprazível a Deus.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεός μου πληρώσει πᾶσαν χρείαν ὑμῶν κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος αὐτοῦ ἐν δόξῃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Theos mou plērōsei pasan chreian hymōn kata to ploutos autou en doxē en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Meu Deus suprirá todas as vossas necessidades conforme as suas riquezas na glória em Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: τῷ δὲ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρὶ ἡμῶν ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: tō de Theō kai Patri hēmōn hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever Amen
verses.literalPt: Ora, a nosso Deus e Pai seja dada glória pelos séculos dos séculos. Amém.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε πάντα ἅγιον ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ ἀδελφοί
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe panta hagion en Christō Iēsou Aspazontai hymas hoi syn emoi adelphoi
verses.literal: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus The brothers who are with me send you greetings . . .
verses.literalPt: Saudai a cada um dos santos em Cristo Jesus. Os irmãos que estão comigo vos saúdam.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς πάντες οἱ ἅγιοι μάλιστα δὲ οἱ ἐκ τῆς Καίσαρος οἰκίας
verses.transliteration: Aspazontai hymas pantes hoi hagioi malista de hoi ek tēs Kaisaros oikias
verses.literal: All the saints send you greetings . . . especially those from the household of Caesar
verses.literalPt: Todos os santos vos saúdam, especialmente os da casa de César.

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou meta tou pneumatos hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit
verses.literalPt: A graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o vosso espírito.
